item.tib: gtsug gtor rigs sngags rgyal mo'i zlog gzhung byad ma sgrol byed
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i/ gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ rigs sngags rgyal mo'i rgyud las zlog gzhung byad ma sgrol byed 'di ni/ rje rin po che gsang sngags mtshungs med zha dmar cod paN 'dzin pa sogs skyes mchog dam pa mang po'i gsung gis bskul ba dang / nye bar bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po snying gi thig ler gyur pa rnams kyis nan tur gyis bskul ngor / snyigs dus gyi rnal 'byor bslab gsum bstan pa'i rjes 'dzin kho bo kun grol grags pa bdag gis shar rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams sa yi thig ler bkod pa dus kyi pho nya ces pa sa pho rta yi lo la brtsams pa kun mkhyen rgyal bstan gtsug rgyan du gyur cig/
